name: GeneticStudiesOnly
summary: The card component of Genetic Studies Only (DUO_0000016). The requester's project intends to use the data for a genetic study purpose the owner allows, and the requester accepted the terms. Outputs the DownloadGrantCredential that Grant download takes.

allowedPurposes.description: Purpose terms the owner allows (meant to be genetic/genotype study purposes). An IntendedDataUseCredential qualifies if any entry of claims.useOnlyFor.purposes is in this list.
